note: Learning-objective tags for NTA mode (data/nta_item_checks.js objectiveTagOf). A tag names one NCERT sub-section objective, e.g. bst.financial_markets.primary_vs_secondary. An NTA paper holds at most one question per tag, or the tag's cap in caps (2 for broad tags). Tags only keep questions apart; they never admit a question. The nta_question_index table (objective_tag column) takes precedence when it is populated.
coverage: Partial. Only the same-concept clusters that the NTA engine review of 13 Oct 2026 named by question (Business Studies, Accountancy and Economics papers in docs/brain/NTA-ENGINE-RUN.md, Review fixes). Tagging every eligible question is an owner decision (who assigns tags and how they are signed); until then the engine also uses its deterministic same-concept checks (data/nta_item_checks.js conflictReason).
agent_note: agent_questions: the tag both agent judges gave alike (scripts/nta-pass-merge.mjs); questions whose judges disagree have no stored tag here, and the engine separates them by the words of both judges' tags (data/nta_item_checks.js conceptKeysOf). Hand-assigned tags in questions take precedence.
